events.title: Papa John's (PZZA) Earnings Expected to Grow: What to Know Ahead of Next Week's Release
events.body: Papa John's (PZZA) doesn't possess the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely earnings beat in its upcoming report. Get prepared with the key expectations.

events.title: Cheesecake Factory (CAKE) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
events.body: Cheesecake Factory (CAKE) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.70% and +1.30%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Domino’s Just Reported Weak Sales and Its Stock Dropped 10% : Here’s Why the CEO Isn’t Worried
events.body: CEO Russell Weiner expects other fast-food chains to report similar headwinds from bad weather and weak consumer sentiment tied to Iran war.

events.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Surpasses Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: Starbucks (SBUX) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +14.23% and +3.92%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
